notes.title: A small update
notes.content:
Hi Mandagon fans,

Just a small update - we will soon be making the Mandagon OST and digital art book available for free!

notes.title: A Little Update
notes.content:
So we’ve uploaded a little patch. We’ve addressed a few issues with spawning out of bounds from pressing esc/pause during loading screens as well as controller prompts being displayed instead of keyboard controls.

As always if you’re having any problems please let us know [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/461560/discussions/0/360671352684631852/]here.[/url]

notes.title: A little update
notes.content:
Howdy! We've published a small update addressing the problems people are having with the xbox one controller. We’ve also smoothed out some of the graphical bugs and glitches that have been cropping up.

If anyone is still having trouble with controls or anything else head over [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/461560/discussions/0/360671352684631852/]here[/url] and let us know!
